ayahs.1: Alif Laam Ra! Yeh aali-shaan kitaab hum ne aap ki taraf utaari hai ke aap logon ko andheron se ujaale ki taraf laayen, un ke parwardigar ke hukm se, zabardast aur tareefon wale Allah ki taraf.
ayahs.2: Jis Allah ka hai jo kuchh aasmanon aur zameen mein hai. Aur kaafiron ke liye to sakht azaab ki kharaabi hai.
ayahs.3: Jo aakhirat ke muqaable mein dunyawi zindagi ko pasand rakhte hain aur Allah ki raah se rokte hain aur is mein tedh-pan paida karna chahte hain. Yehi log parle darje ki gumraahi mein hain.
ayahs.4: Hum ne har har nabi ko is ki qaumi zabaan mein hi bheja hai taake un ke saamne wazaahat se bayan kar de. Ab Allah jise chahe gumraah kar de, aur jise chahe raah dikha de, woh ghalba aur hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.5: (Yaad rakho jab ke) hum ne Moosa ko apni nishaaniyan de kar bheja ke tu apni qaum ko andheron se raushni mein nikaal aur unhen Allah ke ehsaanaat yaad dila. Is mein nishaaniyan hain har ek sabr-shukr karne wale ke liye.
ayahs.6: Jis waqt Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke Allah ke woh ehsaanaat yaad karo jo us ne tum par kiye hain, jab ke us ne tumhein Firaunion se najaat di jo tumhein bade dukh pahunchaate the. Tumhare ladkon ko qatl karte the aur tumhari ladkiyon ko zinda chhodte the, is mein tumhare Rabb ki taraf se tum par bahut badi aazmaish thi.
ayahs.7: Aur jab tumhare parwardigar ne tumhein aagah kar diya ke agar tum shukr-guzaari karoge to beshak main tumhein ziyada doonga aur agar tum na-shukri karoge to yaqeenan mera azaab bahut sakht hai.
ayahs.8: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke agar tum sab aur roo-e-zameen ke tamaam insan Allah ki na-shukri karen to bhi Allah be-niyaz aur tareefon wala hai.
ayahs.9: Kya tumhare paas tum se pehle ke logon ki khabren nahin aayin? Yani qaum-e-Nooh ki aur Aad-o-Samood ki aur un ke baad walon ki jinhen siwaye Allah Taala ke aur koi nahin jaanta, un ke paas un ke Rasool mojize laaye, lekin unhon ne apne haath apne munh mein daba liye aur saaf keh diya ke jo kuchh tumhein de kar bheja gaya hai hum is ke munkir hain aur jis cheez ki taraf tum hamein bula rahe ho hamein to is mein bada bhaari shubha hai.
ayahs.10: Un ke Rasoolon ne unhen kaha ke kya Haq Taala ke baare mein tumhein shak hai jo aasmanon aur zameen ka banaane wala hai, woh to tumhein is liye bula raha hai ke tumhare gunaah maaf farma de, aur ek muqarrar waqt tak tumhein mohlat ata farmaaye, unhon ne kaha ke tum to hum jaise hi insan ho, tum chahte ho ke hamein un khudaon ki ibaadat se rok do jin ki ibaadat hamare baap dada karte rahe. Achcha to hamare saamne koi khuli daleel pesh karo.
ayahs.11: Un ke paighambaron ne un se kaha ke yeh to sach hai ke hum tum jaise hi insan hain lekin Allah Taala apne bandon mein se jis par chahta hai apna fazl karta hai. Allah ke hukm ke baghair hamari majaal nahin ke hum koi mojiza tumhein la dikhaayen aur imaan walon ko sirf Allah Taala hi par bharosa rakhna chahiye.
ayahs.12: Aakhir kya wajah hai ke hum Allah Taala par bharosa na rakhen jab ke usi ne hamein hamari raahen samjhaayi hain. Wallah jo eezayen tum hamein doge hum un par sabr hi karenge. Tawakkul karne walon ko yehi laayeq hai ke Allah hi par tawakkul karen.
ayahs.13: Kaafiron ne apne Rasoolon se kaha ke hum tumhein mulk-badar kar denge ya tum phir se hamare mazhab mein laut aao. To un ke parwardigar ne un ki taraf wahi bheji ke hum in zaalimon ko hi ghaarat kar denge.
ayahs.14: Aur un ke baad hum khud tumhein is zameen mein basaayenge. Yeh hai un ke liye jo mere saamne khade hone ka dar rakhen aur meri waeed se khaufzada rahen.
ayahs.15: Aur unhon ne faisla talab kiya aur tamaam sarkash zidi log naa-muraad ho gaye.
ayahs.16: Is ke saamne dozakh hai jahan woh peep ka paani pilaaya jaayega.
ayahs.17: Jise ba-mushkil ghoont ghoont piyega. Phir bhi use gale se utaar na sakega aur use har jagah se maut aati dikhaai degi lekin woh marne wala nahin. Phir is ke peechhe bhi sakht azaab hai.
ayahs.18: In logon ki misaal jinhon ne apne paalne wale se kufr kiya, un ke aamaal misl is raakh ke hain jis par tez hawa aandhi wale din chale. Jo bhi unhon ne kiya is mein se kisi cheez par qaadir na honge, yehi door ki gumraahi hai.
ayahs.19: Kya tu ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala ne aasmanon ko aur zameen ko behtareen tadbeer ke saath paida kiya hai. Agar woh chahe to tum sab ko fana kar de aur nayi makhlooq laaye.
ayahs.20: Allah par yeh kaam kuchh bhi mushkil nahin.
ayahs.21: Sab ke sab Allah ke saamne roo-ba-roo khade honge. Us waqt kamzor log badaai walon se kahenge ke hum to tumhare tabedaar the, to kya tum Allah ke azaabon mein se kuchh azaab hum se door kar sakne wale ho? Woh jawab denge ke agar Allah hamein hidayat deta to hum bhi zaroor tumhari rahnumaai karte, ab to hum par be-qaraari karna aur sabr karna donon hi baraabar hai, hamare liye koi chhutkaara nahin.
ayahs.22: Jab aur kaam ka faisla kar diya jaayega to shaitan kahega ke Allah ne to tumhein sachcha wada diya tha aur main ne tum se jo wade kiye the un ke khilaaf kiya, mera tum par koi dabaao to tha hi nahin, haan main ne tumhein pukaara aur tum ne meri maan li, pas tum mujhe ilzaam na lagao balke khud apne aap ko malaamat karo, na main tumhara faryaad-ras aur na tum meri faryaad ko pahunchne wale, main to sare se maanta hi nahin ke tum mujhe is se pehle Allah ka shareek maante rahe, yaqeenan zaalimon ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.23: Jo log imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye woh un jannaton mein daakhil kiye jaayenge jin ke neeche chashme jaari hain jahan unhen hameshgi hogi apne Rabb ke hukm se. Jahan un ka khair-maqdam salaam se hoga.
ayahs.24: Kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala ne paakeeza baat ki misaal kis tarah bayan farmaayi, misl ek paakeeza darakht ke jis ki jad mazboot hai aur jis ki tehniyan aasman mein hain.
ayahs.25: Jo apne parwardigar ke hukm se har waqt apne phal laata hai, aur Allah Taala logon ke saamne misaalen bayan farmaata hai taake woh naseehat haasil karen.
ayahs.26: Aur na-paak baat ki misaal gande darakht jaisi hai jo zameen ke kuchh hi oopar se ukhaad liya gaya. Use kuchh sabaat to hai nahin.
ayahs.27: Imaan walon ko Allah Taala pakki baat ke saath mazboot rakhta hai, dunya ki zindagi mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi, haan na-insaaf logon ko Allah bahka deta hai aur Allah jo chahe kar guzre.
ayahs.28: Kya aap ne un ki taraf nazar nahin daali jinhon ne Allah ki nemat ke badle na-shukri ki aur apni qaum ko halaakat ke ghar mein la utaara.
ayahs.29: Yani dozakh mein jis mein yeh sab jaayenge, jo badtareen thikaana hai.
ayahs.30: Unhon ne Allah ke hamsar bana liye ke logon ko Allah ki raah se bahkaayen. Aap keh dijiye ke khair maze kar lo, tumhari baazgasht to aakhir jahannam hi hai.
ayahs.31: Mere imaan wale bandon se keh dijiye ke namazon ko qaim rakhen aur jo kuchh hum ne unhen de rakha hai is mein se kuchh na kuchh posheeda aur zaahir kharch karte rahen, is se pehle ke woh din aa jaaye jis mein na khareed-o-farokht hogi na dosti aur mohabbat.
ayahs.32: Allah woh hai jis ne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai aur aasmanon se baarish barsa kar is ke zariye se tumhari rozi ke liye phal nikaale hain aur kashtiyon ko tumhare bas mein kar diya hai ke daryaaon mein is ke hukm se chalen phiren. Usi ne nadiyan aur nehren tumhare ikhtiyaar mein kardi hain.
ayahs.33: Usi ne tumhare liye sooraj chaand ko musakhkhar kar diya hai ke baraabar hi chal rahe hain aur raat din ko bhi tumhare kaam mein laga rakha hai.
ayahs.34: Usi ne tumhein tumhari munh-maangi kal cheezon mein se de rakha hai. Agar tum Allah ke ehsaan ginna chaho to unhen poore gin bhi nahin sakte. Yaqeenan insan bada hi be-insaaf aur na-shukra hai.
ayahs.35: (Ibraheem ki yeh dua bhi yaad karo) jab unhon ne kaha ke aye mere parwardigar! Is shehar ko amn wala bana de, aur mujhe aur meri aulaad ko but-parasti se panah de.
ayahs.36: Aye mere paalne wale mabood! Unhon ne bahut se logon ko raah se bhatka diya hai. Pas meri tabedaari karne wala mera hai aur jo meri nafarmaani kare to tu bahut hi maaf aur karam karne wala hai.
ayahs.37: Aye hamare parwardigar! Main ne apni kuchh aulaad is be-kheti ki waadi mein tere hurmat wale ghar ke paas basaayi hai. Aye hamare parwardigar! Yeh is liye ke woh namaz qaim rakhen, pas tu kuchh logon ke dilon ko un ki taraf maail kar de. Aur unhen phalon ki roziyan enaayat farma taake yeh shukr-guzaari karen.
ayahs.38: Aye hamare parwardigar! Tu khoob jaanta hai jo hum chhupaayen aur jo zaahir karen. Zameen-o-aasman ki koi cheez Allah par posheeda nahin.
ayahs.39: Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe is budhaape mein Ismaeel-o-Ishaaq (alaihimas-salaam) ata farmaaye. Kuchh shak nahin ke mera paalanhaar Allah duaon ka sunne wala hai.
ayahs.40: Aye mere paalne wale! Mujhe namaz ka paaband rakh aur meri aulaad se bhi, aye hamare Rabb meri dua qabool farma.
ayahs.41: Aye hamare parwardigar! Mujhe bakhsh de aur mere maan baap ko bhi bakhsh aur deegar mominon ko bhi bakhsh jis din hisaab hone lage.
ayahs.42: Na-insaafon ke aamaal se Allah ko ghaafil na samajh, woh to unhen us din tak mohlat diye hue hai jis din aankhen phati ki phati reh jaayengi.
ayahs.43: Woh apne sar oopar uthaaye daud-bhaag kar rahe honge, khud apni taraf bhi un ki nigahen na lautengi aur un ke dil khaali aur ude hue honge.
ayahs.44: Logon ko is din se hoshiyaar kar de jab ke un ke paas azaab aa jaayega, aur zaalim kahenge ke aye hamare Rabb hamein bahut thode qareeb ke waqt tak ki hi mohlat de ke hum teri tableegh maan len aur tere paighambaron ki tabedaari mein lag jaayen. Kya tum is se pehle bhi qasmen nahin kha rahe the? Ke tumhare liye dunya se talna hi nahin.
ayahs.45: Aur kya tum un logon ke gharon mein rehte sehte na the jinhon ne apni jaanon par zulm kiya aur kya tum par woh maamla khula nahin ke hum ne un ke saath kaisa kuchh kiya. Hum ne to (tumhare samjhaane ko) bahut si misaalen bayan kardi thin.
ayahs.46: Yeh apni apni chaalen chal rahe hain aur Allah ko un ki tamaam chaalon ka ilm hai aur un ki chaalen aisi na thin ke un se pahaad apni jagah se tal jaayen.
ayahs.47: Aap hargiz yeh khayaal na karen ke Allah apne nabiyon se wada-khilaafi karega, Allah bada hi ghaalib aur badla lene wala hai.
ayahs.48: Jis din zameen is zameen ke siwa aur hi badal di jaayegi aur aasman bhi, aur sab ke sab Allah waahid ghalbe wale ke roo-ba-roo honge.
ayahs.49: Aap is din gunahgaaron ko dekhenge ke zanjeeron mein mile jule ek jagah jakde hue honge.
ayahs.50: Un ke libaas gandhak ke honge aur aag un ke chehron par bhi chadhi hui hogi.
ayahs.51: Yeh is liye ke Allah Taala har shakhs ko is ke kiye hue aamaal ka badla de, beshak Allah Taala ko hisaab lete kuchh der nahin lagne ki.
ayahs.52: Yeh Quran tamaam logon ke liye ittilaa-naama hai ke is ke zariye se woh hoshiyaar kar diye jaayen aur ba-khoobi maloom kar len ke Allah ek hi mabood hai aur taake aqalmand log soch samajh len.
